comment: Only date, sample and material are in the table. Oxygen, pressure and airflow come from the As Run Test Matrix of the same investigation, joined on the as-run test number. Ignition, outcome and burn time are read from the operator's notes in the same matrix by a language model (siNotes), each kept only with a verbatim quote.

join.label: the BASS As Run Test Matrix (PSI-26 Science Documents, sheet 'as run matrix')

siNotes.label: the BASS As Run Test Matrix

static: Air display is the flow speed measured in the duct, in cm/s (as in BASS-II); several values mean the flow was changed during the test.
